cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

confusable: D209 buys a future win through loss; D236 repeatedly returns to the first hope as already being fulfilled more broadly.
comparison: Domestic shared ownership differs from community participation in a disrupted concert.
seedUse: Keep roof/savings challenges but replace a moral about savings with an actual shared planning choice.
